page.title: How "Builderman" turned a physics app into Roblox
page.sub: The story of David Baszucki, co-founder of Roblox
page.bigIdea: Roblox started as an idea: let people build and share their own worlds. By 2025, about 85 million people played every day.

cards.title: A kid who loved building
cards.front: David grew up in Minnesota loving go-karts, dirt bikes and sci-fi.
cards.back: He was also captain of his high school's TV quiz team. Later he studied engineering at Stanford University.
cards.tryit: Pick something you love and learn how it really works.

cards.title: His first company made physics software
cards.front: Before Roblox, he made a computer program for science class.
cards.back: With his brother, he built Interactive Physics, which let students create their own experiments. In 1998 the company sold for $20 million.
cards.tryit: Think of a tool that would make school more fun. What would it do?

cards.title: The big idea: let everyone build
cards.front: Students loved building things in his physics program.
cards.back: So he and his partner Erik Cassel made a world where anyone could build and share. They first called it DynaBlocks, then Roblox: robots + blocks.
cards.tryit: Build one small thing in Roblox Studio this week.

cards.title: It took years to take off
cards.front: Work started in 2003. Roblox launched in 2006.
cards.back: It grew slowly for years before it got huge. In 2021, Roblox became a public company worth about $45 billion.
cards.tryit: When a project grows slowly, keep building anyway.

cards.title: Players are the creators
cards.front: On Roblox, players make most of the games.
cards.back: Creators can swap Robux for real money. In 2020, about 345,000 creators earned money this way.
cards.tryit: Look at a game you like. What would you change to make it better?

quiz.q: Where does the name Roblox come from?
quiz.why: Robots + blocks. Before that it was called DynaBlocks.

quiz.q: What was David's first company about?
quiz.why: Interactive Physics let students build experiments, and that idea led to Roblox.

quiz.q: When did Roblox launch for everyone?
quiz.why: September 2006, after about three years of building.

quiz.q: What does Roblox let players do that most games don't?
opts: Build and share their own games
quiz.why: Players are also the creators, and some earn real money.
